summary: The filing is a Form 8-K Item 8.01 reporting a 10-for-1 forward stock split of abrdn Physical Platinum Shares ETF (PPLT) effective May 18, 2026. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation event is present. The transaction merely adjusted the number of shares outstanding from 13.7M to 137M and proportionally reduced NAV per share from $178.62 to $17.86, with no economic impact on holders. This is a routine capital structure adjustment for an ETF, not a special situation.
